integrity: Analytical proof reconstructs the exact occupancy coupling and perturbation estimates; standalone standard-library verifier checks exact finite-state distributions and moment formulas. The finite checks do not establish asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Scalar descent and inversion counts of the uniform random-to-top chain started at identity only. The asymptotics assume the number of steps divided by deck size tends to infinity. No full-deck total-variation cutoff, pointwise local limit, convergence rates, or independent priority certification is claimed.
title: Sharp Gaussian cutoff profiles for descent and inversion counts in random-to-top shuffling
